summary: The script is generally well-written and avoids code obfuscation, dynamic code execution, DOM XSS, and sensitive API usage. However, it communicates with two third-party servers (sponsor.ajay.app and evdfrance.fr) for SponsorBlock and video download features, which introduces CRITICAL data transmission risks. No evidence of privacy collection or exfiltration beyond necessary video metadata. Supply chain risk is moderate due to reliance on evdfrance.fr. Overall, the script is functional but carries high risk due to external data transmission.
